name: Okeland Communities
desc: Family-owned Western Australian residential property developer creating housing communities, with roots in Perth home building since 1971.
markets: Western Australia, Victoria and Queensland (per site title)

fin.value_orig: AUD 208.1m revenue (balance date 6/22; IBISWorld Top 500 Private 2022 rank 327)

fit_rationale: Domestic family property developer selling house-and-land lots in three Australian states; only the Melbourne race matches and there is no international brand need, so fit is low.
outstanding: Revenue figure is FY2022 (older than three years) and below Route A; no supporting strength found for Route B; employee count unknown.

name: Skyesports
desc: South Asian esports production studio running tournament IPs such as Skyesports Masters and offering broadcast production and brand integration.
products: esports tournaments (Skyesports League, Championship, Grand Slam, Masters CS2 league), broadcast production, white-label events
customers: brands and game publishers (not named on page)
markets: India and South Asia; Skyesports SEA Championship in South-East Asia
fit_rationale: Small South Asian esports organiser (50+ staff) that sells sponsorship itself rather than buying it; no F1 race in India, so it is not a realistic sponsor.
outstanding: No financials; parent JetSynthesys ownership and funding to verify.

name: InTown Suites
desc: Atlanta-based owner-operator of 195 economy extended-stay hotels in 22 US states offering weekly and monthly rates.
products: furnished extended-stay suites at weekly rates
customers: extended-stay guests, business and group travellers
fit_rationale: Budget US extended-stay chain whose guests pay weekly rates; a premium global sport does not match its customer or its domestic footprint.
category_conflict: potential: Hilton, Marriott Bonvoy, World of Hyatt on the F1 roster
outstanding: Owner not confirmed (Wikipedia: privately held; Starwood Capital bought 50 properties in 2015 - Starwood was delivered in b01); revenue and employees unknown; only one Route C indicator.

name: Musto
desc: British sailing, outdoor and equestrian clothing brand, owned within the Helly Hansen business according to Wikipedia.
products: technical sailing clothing, outdoor and country apparel
parent_ultimate: Canadian Tire (per Wikipedia; current ownership of Helly Hansen requires verification)
fit_rationale: Niche sailing apparel brand inside a larger outdoor group; its marketing goes to sailing, and the only revenue figure is tiny and twenty years old.
category_conflict: potential: many apparel partners on the F1 roster (Puma, Castore, adidas, Tommy Hilfiger, BOSS)
outstanding: Current owner (Helly Hansen ownership may have changed since the Wikipedia text), current revenue, and whether Musto has separate management.
